messages.subject: Issue with SpatialDetectionHistory
parts:
Hi, 

I'm just having some trouble using the SpatialDetectionHistory function. I have data from 2 years, so have assigned session column in the CTtable. I have paired camera stations (with by.cameras = FALSE), so when I create the camop matrix needed, each rowname is listed as PS1__SESS_1, PS2_SESS_1... etc. The issue is that my CTtable has each 'Station' listed as PS1, PS2,PS3 etc. When trying to create the spatial detection history, I get the error Error in spatialDetectionHistory(recordTableIndividual = min30dingoadults, :
items of stationCol in recordTableIndividual are not matched in stationCol of CTtable:

Do i need to change all of the names of the stations in the CTtable manually such that they read PS1__SESS_1, to match the others? I would have thought this wouldn't need to be done based on the workflows in the documentation. 

Any help would be much appreciated!!

Cheers, 

Brendan
